scope: One controlled /usr/bin/true Frida target and one controlled 140-byte JavaScript fixture on Linux; no paid providers, no unrelated projects, no source edits

tools.name: instrument_with_frida
tools.positive: Spawned local /usr/bin/true; observed inline send payload; session detached and cleanup_error null
tools.negative: Nonexistent local executable rejected without starting a session

tools.name: recover_javascript_sources
tools.positive: Wakaru 1.14 structural recovery produced one module and manifest status complete; hash matched original fixture; output directory removed
tools.negative: No malformed-input negative path proven; source transformation only, not runtime equivalence

tools.name: start_frida_session
tools.negative: No unrelated target or attach mode tested

tools.name: frida_session_status
tools.positive: Observed paused session before script and empty script list after unload
tools.negative: Post-close status rejected as invalid session

tools.name: load_frida_script
tools.positive: Loaded inline script into paused session; matching sent payload rea680_cert=true observed

tools.name: unload_frida_script
tools.positive: Returned unloaded=true and independent subsequent status showed scripts=[]
tools.negative: Only a single already-loaded inline script tested

tools.name: resume_frida_session
tools.positive: Resumed paused spawn session; returned state=running
tools.negative: No assertion of inferior exit status

tools.name: close_frida_session
tools.positive: Close returned target_state=unknown; subsequent status rejected disposed session id
tools.negative: No guarantee about target process exit; proves only session handle release

caveat: No tool is universally certified. Each green applies only to the positive scope described. Failed CDP browser tests remain pending.
